---
title: "Heatmaps and prevalence bar plots — Eukaryotic ASVs by health state"
author: "Joana Krause"
date: "2025-12-16"
output: html_document
---

Heatmaps of mean relative abundance for the top 50 ASVs, paired with prevalence bar
plots, for three datasets: healthy corals, diseased corals, and bleached corals.
Each section follows the same pipeline: subset → normalise → top 50 → melt → 
mean per host type → taxonomy labels → heatmap → prevalence bar → combine with patchwork.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
```

# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")
```

# Set global theme

```{r set-theme}
theme_set(
  theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text         = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title   = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(color = "black")
    )
)
```

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEALTHY
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

## 1.1 Heatmap

```{r healthy-heatmap}
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Subset data: Only healthy samples, excluding black coral
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                         coral_health == "healthy" &
                         complexa_robusta != "black coral")
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. Normalize to relative abundance
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_sub, function(x) {
  s <- sum(x)
  if (s == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else x / s
})

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. Keep top 50 most abundant ASVs
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
top_otus <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
ps_top <- prune_taxa(top_otus, ps_rel)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. Melt OTU table to long format
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_top))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_top)) otu_df <- t(otu_df)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_df)
otu_df$SampleID <- rownames(otu_df)

otu_long <- melt(otu_df, id.vars = "SampleID",
                 variable.name = "ASV", value.name = "Abundance",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
otu_long$Abundance <- as.numeric(as.character(otu_long$Abundance))

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. Join metadata (to get complexa_robusta)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_top))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)

otu_long <- left_join(otu_long,
                      sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")],
                      by = "SampleID")

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. Calculate mean relative abundance per ASV per host type
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_df <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.nan(MeanAbundance)) %>%
  mutate(
    MeanAbundance = MeanAbundance * 100,
    ASV = factor(ASV, levels = rev(top_otus)),
    complexa_robusta = factor(complexa_robusta,
                              levels = c("complexa", "robusta", "octocoral"))
  )

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. Add taxonomy labels for y-axis and order ASVs by total mean abundance
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_top))
tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)

plot_df <- left_join(plot_df, tax_df[, c("ASV", "Genus")], by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(y_label = paste(Genus, ASV, sep = "; "))

asv_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(y_label) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(MeanAbundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  pull(y_label)

plot_df$y_label <- factor(plot_df$y_label, levels = rev(asv_order))

# Save mapping of ASV → y_label for reuse in the prevalence plot
asv_label_order_healthy <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(ASV, y_label) %>%
  mutate(y_label = factor(y_label, levels = levels(plot_df$y_label))) %>%
  arrange(y_label)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. Plot heatmap
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
heatmap_plot_healthy <- ggplot(
  plot_df, aes(x = complexa_robusta, y = y_label, fill = MeanAbundance)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue",
                      name = "Mean Rel. Abundance (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Coral host type", y = "Genus; ASV") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
  )

print(heatmap_plot_healthy)
```

## 1.2 Prevalence plot

```{r healthy-prevalence}
# 1. Prune to top ASVs from the subsetted phyloseq object
ps_subset_asvs <- prune_taxa(top_otus, ps_sub)

# 2. Convert OTU table to binary presence/absence matrix
otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_subset_asvs), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_subset_asvs)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_mat[otu_mat > 0] <- 1

# 3. Melt to long format
otu_long <- melt(otu_mat)
colnames(otu_long) <- c("ASV", "SampleID", "Presence")

# 4. Add host type metadata
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_subset_asvs))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)
otu_long <- merge(otu_long, sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")],
                  by = "SampleID")

# 5. Count ASV presence per host type
asv_counts <- otu_long %>%
  filter(Presence == 1) %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(PresentCount = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 6. Total samples
total_samples <- nrow(sample_df)

# 7. All combinations
complete_combos <- expand.grid(
  ASV              = top_otus,
  complexa_robusta = unique(sample_df$complexa_robusta)
)

# 8. % prevalence
asv_prevalence <- left_join(complete_combos, asv_counts,
                            by = c("ASV", "complexa_robusta")) %>%
  mutate(
    PresentCount      = ifelse(is.na(PresentCount), 0, PresentCount),
    RelativeAbundance = (PresentCount / total_samples) * 100
  )

# 9. Add y-axis labels from heatmap
asv_prevalence <- left_join(asv_prevalence, asv_label_order_healthy, by = "ASV")
asv_prevalence$y_label <- factor(asv_prevalence$y_label,
                                 levels = levels(asv_label_order_healthy$y_label))

# 10. Plot
prevalence_plot_healthy <- ggplot(
  asv_prevalence,
  aes(x = y_label, y = RelativeAbundance, fill = complexa_robusta)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "complexa"  = "darkmagenta",
    "robusta"   = "darkolivegreen3",
    "octocoral" = "darkgoldenrod1"
  )) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(5, 10, 15, 20)) +
  labs(
    x    = "ASV",
    y    = "% of all healthy samples",
    fill = "Coral host type"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

print(prevalence_plot_healthy)
```

## 1.3 Combine plots

```{r healthy-combine}
heatmap_plot_healthy <- heatmap_plot_healthy +
  theme(legend.position = "left", plot.margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 5))

prevalence_plot_healthy <- prevalence_plot_healthy +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    plot.margin  = margin(5, 5, 5, 0)
  )

combined_healthy <- heatmap_plot_healthy + prevalence_plot_healthy +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(0.5, 2))

print(combined_healthy)

dir.create("../output/heatmaps", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

pdf("../output/heatmaps/heatmap_barplot_healthy.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
print(combined_healthy)
dev.off()
```

## 2.1 Heatmap

```{r disease-heatmap}
# 1. Subset
ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                         coral_health == "disease" &
                         complexa_robusta != "black coral")
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

# 2. Normalise
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_sub, function(x) {
  s <- sum(x); if (s == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else x / s
})

# 3. Top 50
top_otus <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
ps_top <- prune_taxa(top_otus, ps_rel)

# 4. Melt
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_top))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_top)) otu_df <- t(otu_df)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_df)
otu_df$SampleID <- rownames(otu_df)

otu_long <- melt(otu_df, id.vars = "SampleID",
                 variable.name = "ASV", value.name = "Abundance",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
otu_long$Abundance <- as.numeric(as.character(otu_long$Abundance))

# 5. Join metadata
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_top))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)
otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")],
                      by = "SampleID")

# 6. Mean per ASV × host type
plot_df <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.nan(MeanAbundance)) %>%
  mutate(
    MeanAbundance    = MeanAbundance * 100,
    ASV              = factor(ASV, levels = rev(top_otus)),
    complexa_robusta = factor(complexa_robusta,
                              levels = c("complexa", "robusta", "octocoral"))
  )

# 7. Taxonomy labels
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_top)); tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)
plot_df <- left_join(plot_df, tax_df[, c("ASV", "Genus")], by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(y_label = paste(Genus, ASV, sep = "; "))

asv_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(y_label) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(MeanAbundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>% pull(y_label)

plot_df$y_label <- factor(plot_df$y_label, levels = rev(asv_order))

asv_label_order_disease <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(ASV, y_label) %>%
  mutate(y_label = factor(y_label, levels = levels(plot_df$y_label))) %>%
  arrange(y_label)

# 8. Heatmap
heatmap_plot_disease <- ggplot(
  plot_df, aes(x = complexa_robusta, y = y_label, fill = MeanAbundance)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue",
                      name = "Mean Rel. Abundance (%)") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Coral host type", y = "Genus; ASV") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

print(heatmap_plot_disease)
```

## 2.2 Prevalence plot

```{r disease-prevalence}
ps_subset_asvs <- prune_taxa(top_otus, ps_sub)

otu_mat <- as(otu_table(ps_subset_asvs), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(ps_subset_asvs)) otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
otu_mat[otu_mat > 0] <- 1

otu_long <- melt(otu_mat); colnames(otu_long) <- c("ASV", "SampleID", "Presence")

sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_subset_asvs))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)
otu_long <- merge(otu_long, sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")],
                  by = "SampleID")

asv_counts <- otu_long %>%
  filter(Presence == 1) %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(PresentCount = n(), .groups = "drop")

total_samples <- nrow(sample_df)

complete_combos <- expand.grid(
  ASV              = top_otus,
  complexa_robusta = unique(sample_df$complexa_robusta)
)

asv_prevalence <- left_join(complete_combos, asv_counts,
                            by = c("ASV", "complexa_robusta")) %>%
  mutate(PresentCount      = ifelse(is.na(PresentCount), 0, PresentCount),
         RelativeAbundance = (PresentCount / total_samples) * 100)

asv_prevalence <- left_join(asv_prevalence, asv_label_order_disease, by = "ASV")
asv_prevalence$y_label <- factor(asv_prevalence$y_label,
                                 levels = levels(asv_label_order_disease$y_label))

prevalence_plot_disease <- ggplot(
  asv_prevalence, aes(x = y_label, y = RelativeAbundance, fill = complexa_robusta)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("complexa"  = "darkmagenta",
                               "robusta"   = "darkolivegreen3",
                               "octocoral" = "darkgoldenrod1")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "ASV", y = "% of all diseased samples", fill = "Coral host type") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

print(prevalence_plot_disease)
```

## 2.3 Combine plots

```{r disease-combine}
heatmap_plot_disease <- heatmap_plot_disease +
```

## 3.1 Heatmap

```{r bleached-heatmap}

ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                         coral_health == "bleached" &
                         complexa_robusta != "black coral")
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
ps_sub <- prune_samples(sample_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)

# 2. Normalise
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_sub, function(x) {
  s <- sum(x); if (s == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else x / s
})

# 3. Top 50
top_otus <- names(sort(taxa_sums(ps_rel), decreasing = TRUE))[1:50]
ps_top <- prune_taxa(top_otus, ps_rel)

# 4. Melt
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_top))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_top)) otu_df <- t(otu_df)
otu_df <- as.data.frame(otu_df)
otu_df$SampleID <- rownames(otu_df)

otu_long <- melt(otu_df, id.vars = "SampleID",
                 variable.name = "ASV", value.name = "Abundance",
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
otu_long$Abundance <- as.numeric(as.character(otu_long$Abundance))

# 5. Join metadata
sample_df <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_top))
sample_df$SampleID <- rownames(sample_df)
otu_long <- left_join(otu_long, sample_df[, c("SampleID", "complexa_robusta")],
                      by = "SampleID")

# 6. Mean per ASV × host type
plot_df <- otu_long %>%
  group_by(ASV, complexa_robusta) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.nan(MeanAbundance)) %>%
  mutate(
    MeanAbundance    = MeanAbundance * 100,
    ASV              = factor(ASV, levels = rev(top_otus)),
    complexa_robusta = factor(complexa_robusta,

  )

# 7. Taxonomy labels
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_top)); tax_df$ASV <- rownames(tax_df)
plot_df <- left_join(plot_df, tax_df[, c("ASV", "Genus")], by = "ASV") %>%
  mutate(y_label = paste(Genus, ASV, sep = "; "))

asv_order <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(y_label) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(MeanAbundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>% pull(y_label)

plot_df$y_label <- factor(plot_df$y_label, levels = rev(asv_order))

asv_label_order_bleached <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(ASV, y_label) %>%
  mutate(y_label = factor(y_label, levels = levels(plot_df$y_label))) %>%
  arrange(y_label)

# 8. Heatmap

) +

  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Coral host type", y = "Genus; ASV") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))

print(heatmap_plot_bleached)
```
